verdict.rationale: Published board power, connector requirements, and cooling guidance are a fair axis for any GPU hardware product, including a datacenter OAM accelerator, so the story applies. The evidence pack only gives architecture, VRAM, compute-unit specs, and the OAM form factor. It has no TDP/TBP figure, power-connector details, or cooling guidance for the MI325X, and the vendor product page could not be crawled.
